parsed.why: Unenforced colonial felonies reach conduct only; no gender-identity law, but a documented third-gender tradition and no state targeting or border friction. Thin data on custody and entry keeps it a step below acceptance-with-protections.

No criminalisation and courts actively grant trans relief, with enforced hate-crime and service protections; offset by documented airport gender screening, isolation-based trans custody, and record 2025 anti-LGBT violence including app ambushes.

State detains gender-nonconforming people without charge, police beatings and custody sexual harassment, dating-app sting arrests of visitors, deportation and forced detransition. Criminalisation plus latent capital exposure: near do-not-visit.

State-imposed birth-sex rules: strip searches, custody placement, hospital ward exclusion with a documented death, hostile single-sex-spaces code in force and no remedy shown working. No criminalisation, but tier-1 universal exposure.

Decriminalised, broadly neutral attitudes, gender-identity hate-crime aggravator on paper though unenforced; no documented border friction, police targeting or anti-trans violence. Thin recourse and no recognition machinery remain.
